requirements.rule: APPRENTICE SENIORITY: no clause says it in so many words. Art. 182 c. 1 (PDF p. 126) grants the six scatti 'A tutto il personale', art. 71 applies to the apprentice the normative treatment of the qualified worker, and art. 68 c. 1 pays a percentage of the qualified pay of the level, scatti included: the apprenticeship counts for the scatti and a matured scatto is paid at the apprentice percentage. The first scatto matures after 48 months, so only an apprentice with prior seniority reaches one; the engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship.
requirements.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

requirements.rule: APPRENTICESHIP PROFILES: art. 72 c. 2 gives 48 months to named profiles of levels 2 and 3 and 42 months to named profiles of level 4, and art. 68 c. 1 pays 95% in their fourth year. The profile is not an input: the engine pays them the 36-month track, 100% from month 37 instead of 95%.
requirements.remediation: Let the caller state the art. 72 c. 2 profile and add the 42 and 48 month tracks with the 95% fourth year.

requirements.rule: LEAVE, STABILIMENTI BALNEARI (Art. 114 cc.2 and 4): 108 hours a year and 38 more hours after two years for the new hires, instead of 104 and 36; the seasonal contracts of Artt. 89-90 keep the whole reduction. The engine accrues the hours of the generalità.
requirements.remediation: Add employer and contract facts for the balneari and the seasonal contracts.

requirements.rule: BALNEARI AND ALBERGHI DIURNI: art. 190 c. 5 (PDF p. 134) leaves the stabilimenti balneari and the alberghi diurni out of the sickness rule of the file: they pay the supplements of arts. 250 and 266 over the INPS 50%/66.66%, and the balneari non impiegati work 44 hours a week. Not modelled.
requirements.remediation: Model the special parts of the stabilimenti balneari and alberghi diurni in a sibling file.

requirements.rule: CONTRACT CATERING: collective catering companies apply the June 2025 and June 2026 tranches from September (accordo integrativo 26 June 2024, p. 3); they are modelled in pubblici-esercizi-fipe-angem-ristorazione-collettiva. This file holds the June dates of the other sub-sectors.
requirements.remediation: Use pubblici-esercizi-fipe-angem-ristorazione-collettiva for a collective catering company.

requirements.rule: Art. 13 c. 10 of the renewal of 5 June 2024: the guarantee premium paid with the November 2027 pay to workers without second-level bargaining. The caller pays it as a variable item.
requirements.remediation: Model the 2027 guarantee premium as a conditional allowance.

requirements.rule: HOLIDAY OVERTIME: Art. 126 (PDF p. 99) gives 30% by day and 60% by night for every overtime hour; Art. 132 (p. 103) gives 20% for the hours worked on a festività. No clause links them: art. 126 c. 3 excludes cumulation only with ordinary night work, art. 130 c. 2 only Sunday work with the festività, and the special parts (arts. 246-247, 263-264) and the 2024 renewal repeat or leave them. The engine pays holiday overtime at 30%/60% without the 20%.
requirements.remediation: Confirm whether the 20% of art. 132 is added to the overtime rate on a festività; if so set the bands to 0.5 and 0.8, else close this note.

requirements.rule: The run reads an INPS ruleset marked provisional: the INPS circulars of its year are not published yet, so the rates, the massimale and the minimale (and the hourly contributions of domestic work) are those of the year before, carried over. The indexed amounts change every January: the carried-over values understate them.
requirements.remediation: Replace each provisional INPS ruleset of the year with the values of the INPS circulars of the year, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: The run reads a tax ruleset marked provisional: the sources of its year are not published yet (budget law of the year; regional and municipal surtax resolutions), so the values are those of the year before, carried over. Rules in force by statute (the IRPEF brackets of art. 11 and the deductions of art. 13 of the testo unico of D.Lgs. 117/2026) carry over unchanged; any change of the budget law is not applied.
requirements.remediation: Replace each provisional ruleset of the year with the values of its published sources, drop its provisional flag, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: The CCNL tier and the comporto are counted on the days of one episode and the relapses it continues. A CCNL that sums the sickness of separate episodes over a window (a calendar year, the last three years) can reach a lower tier or the end of the comporto earlier than the engine shows. The run is affected when an earlier episode outside the relapse chain is recorded.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.sickness.day.rules (CCNL tier of a sick day)
requirements.remediation: Add the cumulation window of each CCNL to its sickness rule, with the source, and count the tier and the comporto over it.

requirements.rule: The INPS share of a sick day is the INPS rate times the CCNL daily quota of the current month, counted on the CCNL payable days, when the episode does not let the engine compute the INPS daily base: no SicknessEpisode.inps_base in its relapse chain, an operaio without the days worked or paid of the month before, an impiegato who did not work that whole month, an unknown worker category, or a sector INPS regime (spettacolo). With the base, INPS pays its share on the retribuzione media globale giornaliera of the month before the illness and on calendar days (INPS circ. 134368/1981 point 11). The worker's total for the day is the same; the split between INPS indemnity (outside the contribution base) and employer integration may differ, and with it the contributions.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.sickness.pay.handlers (INPS share of a sick day); ccnl_engine.sickness.base.rules (daily base)
requirements.remediation: Compute the base of an impiegato's partial month (point 11.2 letters d-f), of the sector regimes, and from the closing state of the engine's own runs so the caller need not state it, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: SMALLER COMPANIES: Art. 162 (PDF p. 118) reduces the paga base of the aziende minori dei pubblici esercizi and of the stabilimenti balneari of the third and fourth category (from EUR 2.58 for level 7 to EUR 5.68 for Qa, also in the accordo integrativo of 26 June 2024, pp. 4-6); art. 163 c. 2 prints a contingenza up to EUR 0.51 lower for them. Not modelled. Maximum impact: about EUR 6.19 a month for Qa.
requirements.remediation: Model the Art. 162 base-pay reduction for micro-enterprises with an employer-size input.

requirements.rule: An apprentice whose TFR goes to a pension fund or to the Fondo Tesoreria takes the 0.28-point relief of D.L. 203/2005 art. 8, but not the exemption from the 0.20% Fondo di garanzia contribution of D.Lgs. 252/2005 art. 10 c. 2: no source found says whether the apprentice rate (10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus NASpI and the integration funds) holds a Fondo di garanzia share to exempt. The employer contributions of the run may be overstated by 0.20% of the INPS base.
requirements.calculation: ccnl_engine.severance.relief.services; INPS messaggio n. 5859 of 7 March 2008, par. 3 (art. 8 relief of apprentices); INPS circ. 70/2007 par. 6 (Fondo di garanzia exemption, rates 0.20% and 0.40%)
requirements.remediation: Find an INPS source on the Fondo di garanzia share of the apprentice rate, then exempt it with the other workers or record that none is due.

requirements.rule: TRATTAMENTO INTEGRATIVO SPECIALE (L. 199/2025 art. 1 cc. 18-20, Gazzetta Ufficiale text, https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/atto/serie_generale/caricaArticolo?art.codiceRedazionale=26A00149&art.dataPubblicazioneGazzetta=2026-01-21&art.flagTipoArticolo=0&art.idArticolo=1&art.idGruppo=1&art.idSottoArticolo=1&art.idSottoArticolo1=10&art.progressivo=1&art.versione=1, page sha256 e05f6f864509f87e7488cdae075fe3a1f2632f6f4577b87ee05479a1ed193c1d): from 1 January to 30 September 2026 the workers of the esercizi di somministrazione di alimenti e bevande (L. 287/1991 art. 5) and of the 'comparto del turismo, ivi inclusi gli stabilimenti termali', with employment income of 2025 not above 40,000 EUR, receive 'un trattamento integrativo speciale, che non concorre alla formazione del reddito, pari al 15 per cento delle retribuzioni lorde corrisposte in relazione al lavoro notturno e alle prestazioni di lavoro straordinario [...] effettuate nei giorni festivi'. The employer pays it 'su richiesta del lavoratore' (c. 20), a fact the request has no field for: the engine does not pay it, so the net pay of a worker who asked for it is understated.
requirements.remediation: Add the worker's request of c. 20 to the request, pay 15% of the night and holiday overtime pay of the run as a credit, then remove this note.
